entries.subject: During

spans.text:
### Background

During the late 18th and early 19th centuries, the principality of Gorkha united many of the other principalities and states of the sub-Himalayan region into a Nepali Kingdom.
During the ensuing 10-year civil war between Maoist and government forces, the monarchy dissolved the cabinet and parliament.
